note: Both sets extract the materials and section locations correctly. However, both sets attempt to estimate the coordinates of the points in the plot (CG, GC, NA, SC) and make several errors. For example, Set A incorrectly estimates SC x2 as -0.2 m (it is positive) and GC x3 as 0.05 m (it is 0.0). Set B incorrectly estimates NA x3 as 0.02 m (it is 0.0) and CG x2 as -0.15 m (it is closer to -0.25 m). Because both sets contain multiple inaccurate data points derived from visual estimation, they are of similar quality.
